title: Meta-Labeling, Probability Calibration & Abstention — Calibration Report

semantic_bug_fixes.description: CalibrationStore.calibrate() fallback returned clip(raw_score, 0, 1) for unknown models — this treats a raw score as a calibrated probability
semantic_bug_fixes.fix: Returns 0.5 (neutral, uninformative) with a warning. Raw score clipping is NOT calibration.

semantic_bug_fixes.description: calibrate_batch() same clip fallback for unknown models
CalibrationQuality.eval_is_oos documented in docstring but not stored as a field
semantic_bug_fixes.fix: Added eval_is_oos: bool = False field to CalibrationQuality dataclass; propagated into fit() return value.

semantic_bug_fixes.description: Risk signal abs(prob_target - prob_stop) calibrated as logit-scale raw score — type mismatch
semantic_bug_fixes.fix: Pass probability-difference directly as confidence without running through CalibrationStore calibrator.
Replaced with er.weighted_confidence (calibration-quality-weighted mean of calibrated model confidences).
Changed to Optional[float] = None; None handled explicitly in _build_signals.

semantic_bug_fixes.description: mean_conf computed as unweighted mean; ensemble.weighted_confidence computed but never used
CalibratorArtifact.predict() checked staleness before fitted; unfitted artifact returns STALE instead of UNCALIBRATED
semantic_bug_fixes.fix: Check order: UNCALIBRATED → MISMATCH → STALE → CALIBRATED.

calibration_metrics.reason: No real dataset available. Metrics require OOS model predictions on real Indian equity data.

CalibratorArtifact.temporal_order: UNCALIBRATED checked first to prevent STALE masking unfitted state
